    subjects of the decisions and escalations other sessions recorded since this session's cursor, twelve at most; never whole records
    only a use whose sense an edit put at risk, named; a term an edit makes recur without a definition is held for the stop, and a prompt names one no stop named; silent otherwise
    revelation at the edit: a written file re-checks those of 0 chokepoint invariants it may involve
    the read trace: the file a read tool named
  Stop (regulate) via claude, codex:
    the lexicon check over the changed files (4 now)
    spec: 0 problems, 0 structural defects, 0 open requirements
    the reminder that an active work order is closed with work close
    the terms this session made recur without a definition, in one line with the declare-or-alias command
    the spec gaps this session touched, advisory
    the undeclared entrances in the files it changed, advisory
    practices that fired this session with no enactment since, advisory
    the read trace snapshotted for calibrate
    never refuses: the human is present and decides
